name: Sabrimala Industries India Limited
about: Sabrimala Industries India Limited engages in the trading of mobile phones, tablets, and accessories in India. The company operates in two segments, Trading and Acquisition of Stressed Assets. It is involved in the acquire, purchase, hold, manage, or takeover the whole or part of the business, any moveable or immovable property or stressed assets. In addition, the company distributes household plastic items, including lunch boxes, food containers, and tumblers; consumer electronics, such as TV, microwave, and kettles; and FMCG products. The company was formerly known as Sabrimala Leasing and Holdings Limited. Sabrimala Industries India Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in New Delhi, India.
